verdict.rationale: Bolt has a dedicated security docs page stating it "can check your project for security problems and fix what it finds," which matches the core of the story: the platform reviewing your generated app for security issues. The evidence is a single first-party sentence with no detail on scope or timing. Missing for 10: details on what the scan covers (e.g. backend/database rules, auth, secrets), evidence that it runs before or at publish time, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the scan works.
